title: Sand & Stillness — Wellness Package Folio
description: A hushed, sand-grain layout built for ultra-luxury wellness brands, pairing an italic serif package name with a whisper-thin inclusions list against a warm paper-textured ground. Where most spa templates default to blue water imagery, this one centers dry warmth — pebble, candle, linen — closer in spirit to an Aman printed folio than a digital deck.
philosophy: This template believes restraint is the loudest luxury signal available on a screen. It refuses saturated color, drop shadows, and any element that could be mistaken for a generic hotel amenities slide. Every typographic choice — modest italic size, thin-weight sans inclusions, near-invisible bullet glyphs — is designed to communicate that the brand has nothing to prove. It exists for the guest who is already sold and simply needs quiet, beautiful confirmation of what awaits them.
goodFor: Luxury spa and wellness package reveal slides
Aman, Six Senses, or Como-tier resort sales presentations
avoidFor: Chart-heavy quarterly wellness program performance reviews
High-energy fitness brand or athleisure product launches
Multi-speaker conference decks requiring dense information hierarchy
Budget or value-tier hospitality pitches where warmth reads as under-designed
author: harness

examples.promptCore: The slide should feel like the inside cover of a hand-printed Aman folio — hushed, dry, and warm, as if the paper itself holds residual heat from a sun-warmed stone. Asymmetric composition lets negative space carry the identity weight; the package name settles into a quiet left-edge anchor rather than commanding center stage. The photographic zone implies linen texture, smooth river pebble, or low candlelight — nothing aquatic, nothing energetic. Avoid any element that reads as digital UI chrome, hover state, or promotional badge.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a full-bleed warm-grain image occupying the right two-thirds of the slide; the package name and one-line descriptor anchor in columns 1–4 with generous top-third vertical placement. A near-invisible thin horizontal rule separates the name from the descriptor — no enclosing card or bounding box of any kind. Outer margin holds at roughly 8% on left and bottom edges, preserving the printed-folio breathing quality. A discreet folio mark or deck identifier sits bottom-left, flush to the margin baseline.

examples.promptCore: The slide feels like a page torn from a printed Aman retreat folio — dry, warm, and unhurried, closer to material confirmation than information delivery. A close-cropped textural image anchors the left edge with quiet physical presence, while the inclusions list floats in open air to the right, each line a whispered assurance rather than a data point. Asymmetric calm governs the composition: density lives only in the photograph, and the typography insists on stillness. Avoid gradients, glows, geometric icon sets, or any element that would read as digitally assembled rather than quietly printed.

examples.layoutNotes: 12-column grid with a 9% outer margin; a full-bleed textural panel — macro pebble, folded linen, or a spent candle — occupies the left three columns edge-to-edge, bleeding top and bottom. Package or section label sits in italic serif at modest scale in columns 5–11, anchored by a single hairline rule beneath it. The inclusions list runs below in a thin-weight sans, each entry separated by near-invisible em-dash glyphs with deliberate line-height that prevents crowding; no more than six lines visible at once. A bare folio number sits bottom-right of the text zone; no header band, no footer bar.
